383. Palindrome Ranges

Problem Statement:
Dr. Nadal is given a string of ‘n’ characters(S[1], S[2],...., S[n]). Then he is given Q ranges of the form [L R]. Determine of S[L], S[L+1]... S[R] is a palindrome.
input_spec:
The first line is a string S.
The next line consists of the number of ranges Q
The next Q lines contain two space separated integers L R
output_spec:
Print YES if S[L], S[L+1]... S[R] is a palindrome
Print NO otherwise
